svg.data-power-input: 100-240 VAC per Flex Slot supply (the 865434-B21 supply -48 VDC, the 865428-B21 HVAC/HVDC)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: 1+1 with the redundant power supply enablement kit 866442-B21
svg.data-fans: three single-rotor hot-plug fans with one processor, six with two; one more with the redundant fan kit 866438-B21
svg.data-operating-temp-extended-c: 5 to 10 and 35 to 45, approved configurations only
svg.data-operating-humidity: 8 to 90% non-condensing, 28 C maximum wet bulb
svg.data-cpu: up to two Intel Xeon Scalable processors, first or second generation
svg.data-memory: 16 DDR4 DIMM slots, up to 1.0 TB with 64 GB DIMMs
svg.data-storage-controller: HPE Smart Array S100i embedded (SATA only); Smart Array modular and PCIe controllers optional

rect.data-description: Fault/Locate. User Guide: solid amber - failed, unsupported or invalid; solid blue - normal and being identified; flashing amber/blue one flash per second - failed or predictive failure and identified; flashing amber one flash per second - predictive failure alert.

Online/Activity. User Guide: solid green - online, no activity; flashing green four per second - activity; flashing green one per second - rebuilding, RAID migration, strip size migration, capacity expansion, logical drive extension, or erasing.

Fault/Locate. User Guide: solid amber - failed, unsupported or invalid; solid blue - normal and being identified; flashing amber/blue one flash per second - failed or predictive failure and identified; flashing amber one flash per second - predictive failure alert.

Online/Activity. User Guide: solid green - online, no activity; flashing green four per second - activity; flashing green one per second - rebuilding, RAID migration, strip size migration, capacity expansion, logical drive extension, or erasing.
